touches.text: Outline check (Akien, 2026-10-26): when a ticket is cast, the cheapest model reads it beside the outline sections it touches. A conflict, or an open question in those sections, becomes a question on the ticket, which holds its build until answered. It reads the outline as it stands each time, so editing the outline costs nothing.
build_inspector: python sieves run after a build; reds a component that fails one (no charter, no proofs, a silent device, ...). "We find a new thing, we add a new sieve." → CodeMother (10.3.5)

Owns the inspectors and gates (draft, moving from standalone): build_inspector, plan_inspector, diagnostic_inspector, ticket_inspector, corrosion, exemptions, rehearsal, determinism, import_sieve. [Q#31: all of these to CodeMother? See 17.]
Coding Ticket: what we usually mean.

open_questions.text: Lives in the transient tree (4.3.2) with a 30 day lifetime?
Who clears a trouble when it's fixed: whoever fixed it, by a command (cairn trouble clear <id>)? And does a fixed-then-recurring trouble reopen the same file or start a new one?
Does a task ticket have a workflow (cast → done) and gates like a coding ticket, or just open/closed?
Ideas, intents and questions (the open-question lane) are not tickets today, but each is born, followed and closed. Kinds of Ticket, or their own thing? See 19.18 (question tool).
Is harbor_master a Cairn machine (as today), or does it belong with Ticket (3) since all it reports is tickets? If the gates move to the Ticket tool (3.2.3), harbor_master is left as a pure report.
Are the Claude Code hooks (5.10.5) the CC device's, since they adapt an external program (5.7.3.7.2)? Draft: yes, they are CC's shim reaching into Claude Code.

The session-open banner today also shows "artifacts awaiting review" (101 of them: ideas, intents, sorted tickets). On the to-do list, or not? You've said you review intentions top-down rather than artifacts.
"operator(s)": more than one operator means instances (operator 0 = you, operator 1 = someone else)? And does CC ever act as an operator, or always as the CC device?
